headline: Apply all on a card sends your choices again. The button had been building your choices and dropping them without a word; that is fixed, and if a card ever cannot reach the chat it now says so and shows you the line to paste.

items.prompt_template: One fix. Apply all on a card was doing nothing: it collected your choices and dropped them without saying so. It sends them now, once. If a card ever cannot reach the chat, it tells you and shows the exact line to paste. Typing your instruction into the chat works as before.
